**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1734736

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**AI Risk and Governance Workstream Lead Support Role**

  

**The opportunity**

  

This is an exciting opportunity to join the GDS Risk Management Services (RMS) Innovation Risk function in Gurgaon, India as an Assistant Director/ Manager supporting AI Risk and Governance workstreams. You will assist in translating Responsible AI policy content, regulatory expectations and control requirements into practical governance activities that support the responsible use, purchase, development, deployment and monitoring of AI tools and systems across EY.

  

You will provide hands-on support across assigned workstreams by preparing and maintaining governance materials, coordinating cross-functional reviews, tracking actions and evidence, supporting implementation planning, and preparing concise updates for leadership. The role requires strong analytical judgment, dependable execution and the ability to collaborate effectively in a global environment.

  

You will work with EY Technology, Service Lines, Global Functions, Regions and relevant risk and control stakeholders. You will operate under the workstream lead, taking ownership of defined activities and escalating material risks, blockers or unresolved matters as appropriate.

**Your responsibilities**

  

* Support the workstream lead in planning and delivering assigned AI Risk and Governance workstreams, while maintaining clear visibility of milestones, dependencies, risks and upcoming decisions.
* Coordinate cross-functional reviews involving Global Risk Management, Service Lines, EY Technology, Global Functions, Regions and enabling teams such as Legal/GCO, Data Protection, Information Security, Procurement/Supply Chain and Quality.
* Prepare, review and maintain workstream drafts, guidance, control requirements, templates, action trackers, decision logs and other governance artefacts for review and approval.
* Assist in developing practical implementation plans for new or updated AI guidance and controls, and support communication and adoption across service lines, functions and geographies.
* Support activities across the AI governance lifecycle, including intake, risk assessment, QRM review, validation, release or go-live conditions, evidence readiness and post-deployment monitoring.
* Prepare materials for AI governance forums and leadership reporting, including status updates, decision papers, metrics, risk summaries, meeting notes and follow-up trackers.
* Help assess whether AI systems and tools built, bought, deployed or used by EY align with Responsible AI principles and relevant data protection, information security, third-party risk and quality expectations.
* Conduct research on emerging regulatory expectations, market developments and Responsible AI practices, and summarize potential implications for workstream activities and stakeholder guidance.
* Support in developing and maintaining enablement materials such as playbooks, checklists, FAQs and templates to help teams apply governance requirements.

  

**Technical Skills**

  

* Working knowledge of AI risk, Responsible AI principles, AI governance processes and the AI system lifecycle.
* Understanding of data protection, information security, third-party AI risk, evidence management, issue tracking and governance reporting.
* Familiarity with AI risk assessments, control frameworks, system or model documentation, evidence packs and audit-readiness expectations.
* Exposure to AI regulatory expectations, including the EU AI Act or similar governance frameworks.
* Strong drafting and documentation capability, including preparation of guidance, templates, decision notes, status updates, metrics and review observations.
* Proficient in using digital tools such as generative AI platforms, Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for research, analysis, reporting and presentations.

  

**Business Skills**

  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify gaps, clarify requirements, assess implications and propose practical next steps.
* Ability to manage multiple activities, deadlines and provide timely progress updates to the leadership and stakeholders.
* Effective stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to work with business owners, technology owners and risk or compliance subject-matter professionals.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex topics in a concise, practical and audience-appropriate manner.
* Ability to work through ambiguity, respond to evolving requirements and exercise sound judgment while seeking guidance on material or sensitive matters.
* Collaborative and service-oriented approach, with attention to detail, accountability and action closure.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

  

* Post Graduate degree or equivalent professional qualification in risk management, governance, compliance, technology, information systems, business or a related field.
* Approx. 10 years of relevant experience in risk management, governance, compliance, technology risk, Responsible AI, or related areas.
* Experience with AI, data, privacy or emerging technology regulation and responsible innovation practices is preferred.
* Experience working with Risk Management, technical SMEs and cross-geography stakeholders.
* Working in a Risk Management domain is an advantage.
* Project/program management, risk, compliance or legal certifications are a plus.
* Strong drafting, research, communication and Microsoft Office skills.

  

**What we look for**

  

* Someone who wants to grow into a AI and Risk governance role at EY and develop future-focused skills in AI regulation and responsible innovation.
* A professional who can combine regulatory judgment with practical, adoptable guidance and collaborative stakeholder engagement.
* A passion to learn and contribute to the responsible and ethical procurement, development, deployment and use of AI and emerging technologies across EY.

  

**What we offer**

  

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We'll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

  

* **Continuous learning:** You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager, Engineering, Enterprise Data Platform
description:
As a Data Engineering Manager within the Enterprise Data Platform team at PitchBook, you will lead a team of skilled data engineers responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines, managing large-scale data models, and ensuring the quality, availability, and performance of enterprise data assets. This leadership role combines technical depth, strategic thinking, and people management to enable PitchBook’s data-driven decision-making and analytics capabilities.

  

You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners across Technology & Engineering, Product, Sales, Marketing, Research, Finance, and Administration to deliver robust, scalable data solutions. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a strong background in modern data platforms, cloud architecture, and team development—someone passionate about empowering teams and improving data capabilities across the organization. A core part of this role is shaping an analytics environment that is built for AI agents as much as for people. Our analysts, executives and AI agents should all query the same governed, documented, well-described data and get the same answers. You will lead the team to make that real, with semantic layers, governed metrics, rich metadata, agent-safe access, and evaluation of agent output, and in using agents to build faster and with higher quality.

  
  

This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership role: you will guide architectural decisions, mentor engineers, collaborate with cross-functional leaders, and contribute to building next-generation data and AI capabilities at PitchBook. You will exhibit a growth mindset, be willing to solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, and help create a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose. **Primary Job Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, retain top talent and develop a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Define and drive the data engineering roadmap aligned with enterprise data strategy and business objectives
* Collaborate with senior technology and business leaders to define data platform priorities, architecture, and long-term vision
* Promote a culture of innovation, operational rigor, and customer empathy within the data organization
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of high-quality data pipelines and ELT/ETL workflows across enterprise systems and PitchBook’s platform

Support career development through mentoring, skill-building, and performance feedback  

  

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

* Deep understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), and distributed messaging systems (e.g., Kafka)

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complex data concepts into business value
Demonstrated ability to build high-performing teams and lead through change

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

* Decide which sections are necessary, what information each section should communicate, and how the content should be prioritized.
* Plan enquiry forms and conversion steps according to the campaign objective.
* Ensure the landing page message matches the advertisement that brings visitors to the page.
* Explain the conversion logic behind each major structural and messaging decision.

3. Strategy Documentation & Client Approval

* Prepare a clear, structured strategy document outlining the recommended landing page approach.
* Create wireframes that communicate the page layout, content hierarchy, section sequence, and conversion flow.
* Document the campaign goal, target audience, key messaging, USP, offer, CTAs, and trust elements.
* Explain why each section is included and how it supports the visitor's journey toward an enquiry.
* Share the strategy document and wireframes with the client for review and approval before design begins.
* Identify missing information and ask the client relevant questions before finalizing the plan.
* Incorporate feedback and refine the strategy when required.

4. AI-Assisted Landing Page Design

* Use AI-assisted design tools to turn approved strategies and wireframes into landing page UI designs.
* Create mobile-first layouts that are clear, user-friendly, and aligned with the campaign objective.
* Maintain consistency between the ad message, landing page content, offer, and CTA.
* Apply conversion-focused principles to content hierarchy, page flow, readability, and user experience.
* Ensure the final design follows the approved strategy rather than starting with a template or visual concept.

5. Launch Coordination & Conversion Optimization

* Coordinate with the advertising team and developers to support landing page launch.
* Ensure the intended enquiry actions and tracking requirements are communicated clearly.
* Work with the relevant team members to support enquiry tracking for calls, WhatsApp, forms, or bookings.
* Review post-launch performance and available conversion data.
* Identify potential friction points and recommend changes to improve enquiry generation.
* Suggest improvements to page messaging, structure, forms, CTAs, and user journey based on campaign results.

Required Skills & Experience

* Strong understanding of conversion-focused landing pages and funnel planning.
* Ability to understand business goals, campaign objectives, customer intent, and target audiences.
* Experience planning landing pages for paid advertising campaigns.
* Knowledge of landing page structure, wireframes, content hierarchy, CTAs, and trust-building elements.
* Ability to analyze competitor pages and advertising messages.
* Strong research, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to prepare clear strategy documents and wireframes that clients can understand and approve.
* Confidence in explaining the reasoning behind page structure and design decisions.
* Practical familiarity with AI tools for wireframing and UI design.
* Understanding of mobile-first design and enquiry tracking.
* Ability to collaborate with advertising teams and developers during implementation.

Who Should Apply?

This role is suitable for candidates with experience or skills in:

* Conversion rate optimization (CRO)
* UX strategy and user journey mapping
* Landing page and funnel planning
* Conversion-focused UI/UX design
* Digital marketing and paid advertising funnels
* AI-assisted wireframing and interface design
* Landing page performance analysis

Candidates must be comfortable handling both **strategic planning and AI-assisted page design**. Pure design execution without an understanding of conversion goals is not sufficient.

This Role Is NOT for You If

* You begin projects by choosing a template or creating the visual design before understanding the business goal.
* Your portfolio contains only website screenshots without explaining the objective, strategy, or outcomes.
* You have never prepared a landing page plan or strategy document for a client.
* You cannot explain why particular sections, messages, trust elements, or CTAs are included on a page.

This Role IS for You If

* You can independently plan the journey from an advertisement to a completed enquiry.
* You understand why each landing page section exists and how it contributes to conversion.
* You have planned landing pages for advertising campaigns and can discuss their enquiry or conversion performance.
* You can prepare a clear, practical strategy document that a client can review and approve.
* You are comfortable using AI tools to create wireframes and UI designs efficiently.
* You use research, campaign objectives, customer needs, and performance data to guide your decisions.

Applicants should be prepared to demonstrate landing page projects that show more than the final design. Relevant examples should explain:
